description:
Compiled functions are declared as fz_fn_<id> (src/compiler2/native_codegen/driver.rs declare_spec_fns), so a sampling profile or a debugger backtrace of a built program cannot be read back to source: 40% of the distiller's release profile was generated code spread over 240 anonymous functions. NativeCodegenBody already carries display_name.
Change: the symbol is fz_fn_<id>_<display name with non-alphanumerics as _>. The id keeps it unique.
Trial result: the distiller's generated-code time attributes to the JSON decoder (string 7.7%, object 6.4%, digits 3.0%, run_join 3.6%) and to continuation bodies (deliver_lanes 11.8%).
Signal: a test builds a program and finds a symbol naming one of its functions in the binary's symbol table.
title: A compiled function's symbol carries its source name
